headline: Nidec Mobility Corporation Faces Ransomware Incident
body: Nidec Mobility Corporation, a key player in the automotive components sector, has confirmed a ransomware attack that compromised its internal systems. The incident, which involved the theft of sensitive internal data, was discovered months after the initial breach. Despite the data exfiltration, Nidec Mobility Corporation reported that its operations continued without interruption. Nidec Mobility Corporation is recognized for its contributions to the automotive industry, particularly in the supply of critical components for vehicle manufacturing. The company operates globally, providing essential parts that support the automotive supply chain. In response to the breach, Nidec has engaged cybersecurity experts to mitigate risks and has notified affected individuals accordingly.
